As the sole daughter of the late king of Denmark, princess Scarlet took it upon herself to enact revenge against those who betrayed her father. All her efforts, however, come to naught when her enemies move first and deliver a fatal blow to the princess.

Still, her quest for revenge is far from over. After waking up in the desolate "Land of the Dead," Scarlet realizes that she still has another chance of punishing those responsible for her family's tragedy. Now accompanied by Hijiri, a peculiar young man from a faraway land, the bloodthirsty princess sets off on her renewed hunt for those who wronged her. But the journey through the underworld is perilous, and the answers Scarlet seeks might come from the most unexpected of places.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Nageki no Bourei wa Intai shitai Part 2
title_english: Let This Grieving Soul Retire Part 2
title_japanese: 嘆きの亡霊は引退したい 第2クール
synopsis:
Despite being one of Zebrudia's few level 8 treasure hunters and the leader of the capital's top party, Grieving Souls, Krai Andrey does not deserve his prominent reputation. Everything he says somehow turns prophetic, which convinces everyone around him that he possesses unfathomable wisdom regardless of his utter incompetence. Krai knows his success is only a series of coincidences, but the weight of those expectations grows heavier as time goes by. Unfortunately, as the other members of the Grieving Souls continue to shock the world with their achievements, Krai's wish for a peaceful retirement drifts ever further out of reach.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen - Kashin-tan
title_english: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
title_japanese: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-禍進譚-
synopsis: Final part of Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen.

title: Mahou Shoujo Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS: Gun Blaze Vengeance
title_english: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
title_japanese: 魔法少女リリカルなのは EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
synopsis:
Thirty years ago, the sudden appearance of unknown invasive alien lifeforms nearly brought about the end of the world.

Since then, humanity and these creatures, known as Invasion Species, have continued to clash over living territory. Although human safety is barely being maintained, the world remains on the brink of collapse. As the threat of death and destruction lingers, people go about their daily lives by turning away from the constant danger around them. In response, the United Nations establishes EXCEEDS, an organization tasked with investigating and combating threats caused by the Invasion Species.

The story begins in the Far Eastern island nation of Mizuho, where Shiina Kuze, a young hunter who exterminates invasive species, lives on a remote island. Wanting nothing more than a quiet life with her only family—her younger sister, Setsuna—Shiina's routine is disrupted when an unexpected incident occurs, drawing her into a much larger conflict.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie 4: You're Next - A Piece of Cake
title_english: My Hero Academia: You're Next - A Piece of Cake
title_japanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ユアネクスト《A PIECE OF CAKE》
synopsis: Adaptation of "A Piece of Cake" side-chapter in the Vol.Next manga which was a special present for movie attendees in Japan. Included in the "Plus Ultra" version of the film's Blu-ray and DVD release in Japan.

title: Hibi wa Sugiredo Meshi Umashi
title_japanese: 日々は過ぎれど飯うまし
synopsis:
Introverted university student Mako Kawai has a hobby of watching food videos and cooking what she learns from them. She is now a far cry from her energetic self back in elementary school—due to her growing social anxiety, she fears trying new things, such as going to restaurants alone or even making friends.

Enter Shinon Ogawa, one of Mako's childhood friends with whom she reunites in college. Still as extroverted as ever, Shinon quickly adopts Mako into her friend group, which includes the easygoing Tsutsuji Higa and the level-headed Kurea Furutachi. Together, they are planning to start a Food Culture Research Club and invite Mako to join as their fourth member. Though she initially declines, Mako soon realizes that this is her chance to finally brighten up her days, enjoy life surrounded by friends, and eat delicious food with everyone!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Neko ni Naritai Tamagawa-kun
title_english: Tamagawa Wants to be a Cat
title_japanese: 猫になりたい田万川くん
synopsis:
For Tamagawa, volunteering at a cat café is the only relief from his stressful job. The manager tells him to, "relax and learn to be spoiled," but he doesn't know what that means until a new customer, Rai Shindou, comes to the café and tells Tamagawa he wants to keep him as a cat! Enter their strange, but fateful relationship. A pure-hearted and soothing romantic comedy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Futari Solo Camp
title_japanese: ふたりソロキャンプ
synopsis:
Gen Kinokura is a solitary camper looking for time away from the crowded city to refresh his mind and enjoy nature. But one day, Gen meets Shizuku Kusano at the supposedly empty campsite. A complete beginner at camping, Shizuku tries to settle in with Gen despite his protests. Gen reluctantly gives in once he notices her lackluster preparation.

Offering advice for her next trip, Gen believes their interaction ends on this occasion. However, Shizuku decides to join his future solo outings to learn more about camping. Although no longer on their own, the two set rules on how to camp together, allowing them a give-and-take experience while still relishing the atmosphere in a form of solitude.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru
title_english: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
title_japanese: 貴族転生 ～恵まれた生まれから最強の力を得る～
synopsis:
Noah Ararat is born into privilege as the 13th prince of an imperial dynasty and granted an existence most can only envy. After all, apart from the access to the empire's finest education and resources, Noah is a reincarnator with the memories of his previous life intact, blessed with an infinite level cap and an elite ability that allows him to utilize his subordinates' skills.

Within the imperial court, however, status alone offers no guarantee of safety. While Noah's overwhelming potential sets him apart from his siblings from the moment he begins his training, it also draws the attention of nobles whose interests extend far beyond governance. Inevitably, Noah must learn to navigate the expectations of royalty and the mechanics of his unusual power, as he realizes that privilege invites control as readily as it grants it.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Fermat no Ryouri
title_japanese: フェルマーの料理
synopsis:
Since childhood, Gaku Kitada has been fascinated with mathematics. As a student at the prestigious Wels Academy, he aimed to qualify for the Mathematics Olympiad and eventually secure admission to the University of Tokyo to become a great mathematician. His ambitious plans, however, do not come to fruition, as Gaku fails to qualify for the Olympiad's main event due to his anxiety and lack of self-confidence. This disastrous performance, coupled with his decision not to participate in future competitions, leads to his expulsion from the academy.

During this crisis, Gaku meets Kai Asakura, an enigmatic professional chef who recognizes Gaku's peculiar way of cooking that incorporates math to create perfectly synergistic dishes. Despite his initial reservations, Gaku begins to utilize his mathematical perspective to cook, rekindling his love for the subject in the process. Wanting to understand this impulse more, Gaku decides to pivot his career trajectory to one that melds numbers with flavors to find solutions that can satisfy both his mind and the palate of his customers.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ajin ga Osuki nan desu ne
title_japanese: 亜人がお好きなんですね
synopsis:
In the near future, humans and animals live in harmony. The result is the emergence of half-humans who live like normal people, but with their own characteristics.

Episode 1: The decent and clean goat Maya periodically shaves her fur on the lower part of her body, which she is very embarrassed about, because many people would dislike it. One day, right while shaving, her owner Christophe catches her. The girl has already managed to get upset, but in vain. What is natural is wonderful. And the young lord was eager to help her.

Episode 2: Little Meguru unexpectedly met a big dog Mokka in an alley and got scared and wet himself. The dog calmed the boy down and invited him over to dry his clothes and take a shower. But as soon as the husky took off her clothes to help him in the bath, the boy could no longer think about anything but her.

title: My Melody & Kuromi
title_japanese: My Melody & Kuromi
synopsis:
When My Melody's visit to the Cloud Kingdom leads to a whirlwind of trouble, can she, Kuromi and their friends save their home before it's too late?

(Source: Netflix)

title: Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai
title_japanese: 水属性の魔法使い
synopsis:
After getting caught up in an accident, Ryou Mihara is reincarnated in the world of Phi as a water magician. Waking up in a remote forest, he sets out to achieve his ideal slow life by living off monsters and refining his magic. Unbeknownst to Ryou, in his second life he has gained the hidden trait "Eternal Youth."

One day, Ryou stumbles across a shipwrecked adventurer named Abel. As Abel requests Ryou to accompany him to the town of Lune, they embark on a journey through mountains infested with monsters. Upon arriving at the town and registering as an adventurer, Ryou's powerful water magic and equipment are unlike anything anyone has ever seen before. Although his prowess piques the interest of many, Ryou is eager to begin his own adventure and hone his magic even further!

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru
title_english: With You, Our Love Will Make It Through
title_japanese: キミと越えて恋になる
synopsis:
When high schooler Mari bumps into a fellow tardy student, she's surprised to find out he's a beastfolk who's to attend her school! After all, it's not rare for beastfolk to coexist alongside humans, but it's still uncommon, with the prejudice and all. Nervous to meet one at first, Mari soon learns there's more to him than his furry exterior. In fact, the more she gets to know him, the more she finds herself drawn to him, his steadfastness, his kindheartedness, and... his body...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Alma-chan wa Kazoku ni Naritai
title_english: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!
title_japanese: アルマちゃんは家族になりたい
synopsis:
The Apotheosis Loyal Maneuver Arms—Alma—is the flagship prototype of Enji Kamisato and Suzume Yobane, two gifted researchers disillusioned by the arrogance of their peers. Although designed for combat, Alma's daily life ironically unfolds far from any battlefield, as she is fine-tuned for ordinary society. Nevertheless, within the modest household she shares with her creators-turned-parents, she learns the subtleties of being human little by little.

Meanwhile, Enji and Suzume, as self-proclaimed rivals, remain oblivious to how transparent their affection for each other truly is. Alma, observing their every exchange with methodical precision, is hardly deceived. As the pair continue their quarrels under the guise of research, Alma adapts to the rhythm of a homely life—finding comfort in the everyday shenanigans that make them a family.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yuugao
title_japanese: 夕顔
synopsis: Tomoe, a strict and disciplined teacher, starts every working day with a genuine desire to teach students to be smart. Soon, she was respected and appreciated in the educational institution. It would seem that everything will continue like this, but lately, in the moonlight, the woman has been troubled by strange dreams. It started to make it difficult to focus on work, especially if there were male students nearby.

title: Majutsushi Kunon wa Mieteiru
title_japanese: 魔術師クノンは見えている
synopsis:
Kunon Gurion is born without sight. Refusing to accept blindness as an unchangeable fate, he devotes himself to water magic. His series of personal experiments quickly reveals his talents, as Kunon's grasp of magic grows at a pace that surpasses even those tasked with teaching him.

Through constant trial and invention, he develops methods of perceiving the world that do not rely on ordinary vision, reshaping water into constructs that allow him to navigate his surroundings. His ingenuity and rapid progress soon draw attention beyond his lessons, setting him on a path of discovery that tests the very limits of possibility—as well as of his own body.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Koori no Jouheki
title_japanese: 氷の城壁
synopsis:
On the surface, high school student Koyuki "Koyun" Hikawa seems unapproachable and terrifying to most other students. In reality, Koyun is just insecure and prone to overthinking due to her uncomfortable experiences in middle school. However, her chance encounter with two boys in school—Minato Amamiya and Youta Hino—sparks a change in her. Like her friend Miki Azumi, the boys are never afraid to approach Koyun and see her for who she really is.

Although Koyun starts spending more time with Miki, Minato, and Youta, she finds herself torn between her newfound bliss and her fear of getting too attached to others. Meanwhile, each of her friends quietly struggles with their own challenges. But as the new friend group continues to navigate high school together, Koyun and the others start to break out of their shells and enjoy their adolescence to the fullest.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chanto Suenai Kyuuketsuki-chan
title_english: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
title_japanese: ちゃんと吸えない吸血鬼ちゃん
synopsis:
In the city of Kashinokidai, where humans coexist with other beings, one individual stands out even among this diversity. Transfer student Luna Ishikawa, a vampire with a cool and mysterious aura, captivates her classmates and gains instant popularity.

Tatsuta Ootori, an otherwise unremarkable boy, believes that Ishikawa is far beyond his reach. However, when the two are paired for cleaning duty, Ootori discovers that beneath Luna's composed exterior lies an ironic secret. She cannot properly suck blood, forcing her to eat snacks to hide her weakness—but no amount ever seems to satisfy her.

Determined to help Luna master the very skill that defines her kind, Tatsuta offers himself as her practice partner. Through trial, error, and multiple bandages, their unassuming high school days take on a peculiar warmth—one where Luna no longer needs to act flawlessly and can simply be her natural, adorably awkward self.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kairyuu to Yuubinyasan
title_japanese: カイリューとゆうびんやさん
synopsis:
Hana, a young girl from the Paldea region who admires the postman Dragonite and aspires to become an ace mail carrier, one day receives a letter with no address. Determined to find the sender, she embarks on a frantic search alongside her partner, Hogator. After running around town, she finally tracks down the sender—a boy named Rio. Upon hearing his story, Hana learns that Rio wrote the letter to celebrate his father's birthday, who is stationed alone in the Kanto region. However, the day of his father's birthday has already arrived...

(Source: Official YouTube, translated)

title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusenmochi Datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
title_english: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
title_japanese: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
synopsis:
Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kizetsu Yuusha to Ansatsu Hime
title_english: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
title_japanese: 気絶勇者と暗殺姫
synopsis:
Toto has been dreaming about adventuring with other people for as long as he can remember. Despite his hero title, he still remains without allies due to his timid personality. Therefore, when three women: Ciel, Anemone, and Goa suddenly request to join him, Toto is overjoyed. Unbeknownst to him, they are all assassins assigned to eliminate him!

While Toto resolves to protect his would-be killers, the women fight over who can finish off the hero. As Toto remains oblivious of his new party members' true intentions and finds himself passing out every time he gets flustered, the four of them embark on their peculiar adventure into the greater world.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Taiyou yori mo Mabushii Hoshi
title_english: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
title_japanese: 太陽よりも眩しい星
synopsis:
Sae Iwata was never cute or dainty like the other girls, and due to her build and strength, she always felt the need to look after her delicate childhood friend and crush, Kouki Kamishiro. But as years passed, Kouki grew taller and more confident, which resulted in them drifting apart.

Toward the end of middle school, Sae reconnects with Kouki. Seeing that Kouki is still the sweet boy she once knew, she realizes that her dormant feelings for him have resurfaced. She tries her best to suppress her emotions—but it becomes even more difficult as, come high school, they end up in the same class. Ignoring her deepening feelings may seem like a fool's errand, but this boy that shines brighter than the sun may just prove to be her destiny.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tian Guan Cifu Short Films
title_japanese: 天官賜福 全新动画短片
synopsis:
A series of short films.

Short film #1: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng's first encounter.

Short film #2: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng enjoy the Lantern Festival at the Ghost Market.

Short film #3: Xie Lian and Hua Cheng are underwater then they return to Ghost City.

Short film #4: A surprise discovery in a mountain cave.

title: Motokare to wa Dekinakatta Sex Shitemo Ii desu ka?
title_japanese: 元カレとはできなかったセックスしてもいいですか?
synopsis: Mia, a cute and passionate gamer girl recently ended her relationship with her boyfriend due to the lack of intimacy in their sex life. Feeling unsatisfied and frustrated, Mia opens up about her situation to her close gaming friend, who is also dealing with his own romantic frustrations. What starts as a simple, honest conversation between two friends soon takes an unexpected and steamy turn, as both Mia and her gaming buddy explore desires they've been suppressing.

title: Replica datte, Koi wo Suru.
title_english: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
title_japanese: レプリカだって、恋をする。
synopsis:
On days when Sunao is sick, or not feeling like going to school, she is called to take her place. She was born to this world when Sunao wished to have a substitute. No one knows that she exists, but she tries to do her best for Sunao whenever she is called. One day she talks with Sanada, one of her classmates. They become friends, but soon he notices that she is different from the original Sunao...he was the first one who did. She tells him to talk with her only when she has her hair half-up. Sanada does like she told him, and they enjoy their time together. As they become closer, she realizes that she has special feelings toward Sanada. But she doesn't know what will happen to her...if she, a replica, falls in love.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title: Hitozuma no Kuchibiru wa Kan Chuuhai no Aji ga Shite
title_english: Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
title_japanese: 人妻の唇は缶チューハイの味がして
synopsis:
When college student Tsuyoshi returns to his apartment from a convenience store, he is surprised to see Yui Kooriyama at his doorstep. Sent by his mother to check up on him, Yui forces herself inside his personal living space. Despite Yui already being married, the seemingly normal visit takes a sudden turn when they get drunk and spend a night together. As he is invited for more drinks by other married women, Tsuyoshi finds himself sharing all kinds of intimate moments with them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ansatsusha de Aru Ore no Status ga Yuusha yori mo Akiraka ni Tsuyoi no da ga
title_english: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
title_japanese: 暗殺者である俺のステータスが勇者よりも明らかに強いのだが
synopsis:
After being transported with his classmates to another world, composed and hard-working Akira Oda quickly makes a series of unsettling discoveries. When the Japanese students are blessed with magical powers, Akira notices that although he has received the assassin class, Tsukasa Satou—who was given the strongest hero class—is no match for him.

Doubting the words of King Edmond Rose Retice, who urges the new heroes to slay the demon king, Akira decides to conceal his powers and discover the truth of this world. While his classmates fall one after another under the hypnosis of Queen Maria Rose Retice, Akira allies with the Retice Knight Commander Saran Mithray to hone his skills.

Alas, in a shocking turn of events, Akira is framed for the murder of a high-profile individual of the castle and forced into exile. After hiding in a dungeon where he can level up unnoticed, Akira sets out on a journey to become strong enough to thwart the evil plans of King Retice and ultimately return to his world—where the survival of his loving family rests upon his shoulders.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Neko to Ryuu
title_japanese: 猫と竜
synopsis:
An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named "Uncle Wings" is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. As Uncle Wings grows, he becomes the cats' protector, determined to keep them safe from humans. But as he watches the cats connect with humans using their magic, Uncle Wings slowly starts to warm up to humans in this heartfelt, bittersweet tale.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Ninja to Gokudou
title_japanese: 忍者と極道
synopsis:
Since ancient times, the ninja and the yakuza have been at war, spilling blood around the world as empires rise and fall. So when, in the modern age, Shinoha, a ninja, meets Kiwami, a gangster following the path of the yakuza—the gokudo—and discovers they have common interests, the obvious assumption is that nothing good can come of it. But can it be that one burgeoning bromance will shake up a 300-year grudge?

Who will win the struggle for real ultimate power?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Shuumatsu Touring
title_japanese: 終末ツーリング
synopsis:
All alone after the end of days, two girls bike through the empty ruins of Japan—and they're not about to let the collapse of civilization get in the way of sightseeing! Even when the world ends, their journey goes on.

(Source: Yen Press)

title: GANSO! BanG Dream Chan
title_japanese: 元祖！バンドリちゃん
synopsis:
BanG Dream Chan — who took the world of girl bands by storm — is back!?

A poppy, cute, all-star gathering of band members, an avant-garde, laugh-out-loud girl band comedy full of charm!

"Come join us, BanG Dream Chan  — you're BanG Dream Chan, and so am I!"

GANSO! BanG Dream Chan is a new mini Anime series for BanG Dream!, featuring members of the ten bands from BanG Dream!.

(Source: Official BanG Dream! Website)

title: Beastars Final Season Part 2
title_japanese: BEASTARS (新章)
synopsis: Second part of Beastars Final Season.

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai
title_english: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
title_japanese: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい
synopsis:
Fourteen-year-old Sheena Totsuki has been surrounded by war and death for as long as she remembers. She is forced to train with fellow orphans as child soldiers to fight tooth and nail in a conflict that has dragged on for too long. Casualties are a common occurrence, as is the case for Sheena's roommate one tragic day.  

That night, Sheena encounters a strange girl covered in blood with a contradictory joyous demeanor. The next day, the strange girl is introduced to Sheena's class as Mimi Kagari, and rumors start floating around that she could be the orphanage's infamous secret weapon of the same name. Appointed as Sheena's new roommate, Mimi immediately grows attached to her, while Sheena tries to sort out her own feelings on the matter. Mimi seems mysteriously unfamiliar with  the school and everyday life as a student, so Sheena finds herself becoming something of a caretaker.

Despite barren circumstances, the disparate pair grows closer. However, Sheena's worldview begins to crumble after she learns the truth behind Mimi's unimaginable power.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyoubinbou
title_japanese: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏
synopsis:
"Orhun Dura, today will be your last day in the party."

Orhun, once a skilled Swordsman, had adapted to the role of Enchanter to fill a crucial gap in the Hero Party. However, one day, the party leader abruptly dismisses him, claiming his skills are lacking. Branded a "weakling" and a "jack of all trades, master of none," by his former comrades, Orhun is cast out without a second thought.

Determined to start anew, he returns to adventuring—this time as a Swordsman, the role he originally excelled in. But his time as an Enchanter was far from wasted. The experience, knowledge, and countless original spells he developed in the Hero Party have forged him into a warrior unlike any other. Now, armed with an unconventional set of skills, Orhun is ready to carve his own path—one that will prove his true strength to the world.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Ruri Dragon PV
title_japanese: ルリドラゴン PV
synopsis: Promotional video in collaboration with ZUTOMAYO and coalowl to commemorate the release of the third manga volume.

title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai Pilot
title_english: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day Pilot Film
title_japanese: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい Pilot
synopsis: Pilot video for Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai.

title: Gensou Suikoden
title_japanese: 幻想水滸伝
synopsis:
Our story's hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City- States of Jowstown. A few months earlier, a truth agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder...

(Source: ANN)

title: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun
title_japanese: さわらないで小手指くん
synopsis:
Seiwa University High School is renowned for its elite athletes and national-level sports teams. Despite not playing any sports himself, Kouyou Kotesashi enters the school hoping to become a sports doctor and accepts a live-in position as a dormitory's caretaker. Upon his arrival, Kotesashi learns that the dorm is also home to five skilled female athletes: Aroma Kusunoki, Miyuki Hongou, Izumi Sumiyoshi, Chiyo Sayamagaoka, and Aoba Kitahara.

Although faced with skepticism, Kotesashi quickly proves his worth by using his vast knowledge of the human body and massage techniques. With a single touch, he identifies what is troubling each of the girls and helps them recover properly. When the chairman promises him a scholarship if he takes care of the girls' well-being, Kotesashi is determined to ensure that they stay in top shape.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tamaranai no wa Koi nano ka
title_japanese: たまらないのは恋なのか
synopsis:
Misuzu was branded a delinquent when a small incident left him isolated. But one day, he sees the top student, Kitahara, get surrounded by bullies and decides to help him out. That sparked Kitahara's interest in the lonely boy, but Misuzu pushes Kitahara away. "If you get involved with me, you'll get ostracized by everyone else too." But it won't take long for Misuzu's resolve to falter...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Onmyou Kaiten Re:Birth
title_japanese: 陰陽廻天 Re:バース
synopsis:
Teenage delinquent Takeru Narihira has been having a recurring dream where he is chased by monsters, only for a mysterious girl to always rescue him. Having fallen in love with her, he promises her on their 1,999th meeting that he will be the one to save her the next time. But a motorcycle accident sends Takeru to Denji Heian-kyo—an alternate version of Japan's ancient capital with futuristic technology and the home of the girl from his dreams, Tsukiyima, who does not recognize him.

However, a black mist soon descends upon the city, petrifying citizens and unleashing monsters called oni. Only the so-called onmyouji—sorcerers who wield mystical powers and pilot magical "shikigami" suits—can fight them. When the mist returns, Takeru discovers that he has strange transformation powers and can resist the oni. But he and Tsukimiya are ultimately killed, and Takeru awakens in Denji Heian-kyo once again, this time two weeks before the appearance of the mist. Swearing to protect Tsukimiya at all costs, Takeru vows to become an onmyouji and change the future.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tensei shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu
title_english: A Tale of the Secret Saint
title_japanese: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す
synopsis:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes... and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai
title_english: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
title_japanese: 東島丹三郎は仮面ライダーになりたい
synopsis:
Tanzaburou Toujima has spent his entire life chasing a dream: to become Kamen Rider. Now, at 40, reality has nearly caught up with him, and he's on the verge of letting go of his childhood fantasy.

That is, until he gets caught up in a crime wave led by the "Fake Shocker" gang—turning his long-time dream into something far more dangerous.

What starts as a pretend hero's journey quickly becomes something real. The ultimate Kamen Rider fantasy is about to begin!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Akogare no Onna Joushi ga, Aibeya Shucchou no Tonari no Bed de Zetsurin Otoko ni Netorarete Iru
title_japanese: 憧れの女上司が、相部屋出張の隣のベッドで絶倫男に寝取られている
synopsis:
On his first day at the publishing company, Shota Tendo fell in love. The object of his affection was Yui Yamanobe, who had been assigned as his mentor.

With a bust over 90 centimeters, a toned waist, long, slender legs, and a beauty that seemed almost divine, she was stunning. But Yui wasn’t just about her looks. She was an editor in her fifth year at the company, already responsible for several popular works. Despite her accomplishments, she never flaunted them and treated Shota with a warm and approachable demeanor, making her both an admirable boss and an inspiring figure to him.

As they worked together, the distance between them gradually diminished. However, Shota, lacking any experience in love, struggled to summon the courage to step forward as a potential partner for Yui, who herself had confided in him about her insecurities in romance.

Amidst these days of uncertainty, an opportunity arose, a business trip for a gravure photoshoot, where Shota and Yui would be working together.

(Source: EroEro News)

title: Black Torch
title_japanese: BLACK TORCH
synopsis:
Capable of communicating with animals, Jirou Azuma, a troublesome 17-year-old high school student, is constantly scolded by his grandfather for fighting humans that harm his winged and four-legged friends. However, after Jirou saves a black cat named Ragou from certain death, his carefree existence soon comes to an end.

Unbeknownst to Jirou, Ragou is no ordinary cat but a mononoke, a magical creature of immense power. While trying to protect Ragou from another mononoke, Jirou is easily defeated and left for dead. In a dramatic turn of events, Ragou decides to pay off his debt to the dying young man, making Jirou a rare human-mononoke hybrid that easily overpowers his aggressor.

Unfortunately, Jirou is now sought by both Ragou's kin who want to use the latter's powers, and the Bureau of Espionage, a secret governmental organization protecting civilians against hostile mononoke. Forcibly enlisted by the Bureau of Espionage's Ryousuke Shiba, Jirou must prove his worth in a new anti-mononoke task force, lest he be killed as a menace himself.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Sozai Saishuka no Isekai Ryokouki
title_japanese: 素材採取家の異世界旅行記
synopsis:
Living in constant monotone, Takeru Kamishiro longs for a change in his life. His wish is seemingly granted when a god reincarnates him in Madeus, a world trapped in a cycle of collapse. Hoping that Takeru's presence might finally save the world, the god grants him invaluable gifts: a new body with potent magic, a bottomless bag, and a skill that allows him to locate and appraise materials and treasures.

Thrust into a new adventure, Takeru begins his new life exploring freely and collecting valuables to sell. However, as he journeys alongside a newly hatched dragon, his quiet actions start to send ripples across the world—subtly changing its future toward the unseen.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana
title_english: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
title_japanese: 上伊那ぼたん、酔へる姿は百合の花
synopsis:
For Ibuki Tonami, drinking alcohol is her favorite way to unwind from her college studies and duties as her dormitory's resident assistant. However, due to past bad experiences with others, Ibuki feels insecure about the hiccups she gets when drinking and therefore only drinks alone. But as first-year student Botan Kamiina moves into the same dormitory, things begin to change.

During an outing with their dormmates, Botan coincidentally spots Ibuki drinking by herself. Although she has never tried alcohol before, Botan is curious about Ibuki and her drink. Ibuki willingly shares her drink, and it turns out that drinking alcohol turns the usually well-mannered, cheerful Botan into an assertive flirt.

The other residents of their dormitory are shocked to discover that the withdrawn Ibuki has started drinking with Botan. Every new drink Botan tries becomes a fond memory, and she hopes to gradually break Ibuki out of her shell so that the two can enjoy drinks with the others one day.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: All You Need Is Kill
title_japanese: ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
synopsis:
After an unidentified plant from outer space invasion, Rita finds herself trapped in a time loop, forced to relive the same day over and over again. With each loop, she learns. She fights. Her memories and experiences sharpen her skills, turning her into a formidable warrior. Yet, the endless cycle of death and solitude begins to wear her down. Then, she meets Keiji. "I've been repeating this day too," he says. Two lost souls, trapped in an endless war. Could their meeting change fate?

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan)

title: Dead Account
title_japanese: デッドアカウント
synopsis:
Always ready for a fight! Destruction for destruction's sake! The online streamer Aoringo is a troll, making the worst of the worst of boundary-pushing flamebait content and raking in the revenue from the hate-watchers. You may think he's nothing more than a bottom feeder and a drain on society, but in reality, he's high school dropout Souji Enishiro, a caring older brother with a sweet tooth who loves nothing more than his little sister. His viral videos? Just a way to pay his sister's medical bills. And even if all of humanity hates him, he doesn't care, so long as his little sister gets better. But then, something very strange begins to happen...  Don't miss the debut of this modern-day occult exorcism battle manga!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Shuumatsu no Walküre III
title_japanese: 終末のワルキューレIII
synopsis:
In the tournament that pits immortal gods against mortal heroes, humanity has finally equalized the score, standing on even ground with its rulers, to the bewilderment of the latter. Zeus, irate beyond all measure, sends his brother Hades, the legendary king of hell, for the next duel. 

Facing a new desperate situation, Brunhilde, the Valkyrie who leads the fight for the survival of the human race, decides to use her trump card: China's first and most formidable emperor Qin Shi Huang. In the ensuing fight against Hades, Qin Shi Huang will have to prove that among humans and gods, only him deserves to be called king. 

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mononoke Movie 3: Hebigami
title_japanese: 劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神
synopsis: Third installment of the Mononoke movie.

title: Tensei shitara Dragon no Tamago datta
title_japanese: 転生したらドラゴンの卵だった
synopsis:
Our hero wakes up one day in a brand new world…but his new life doesn’t come with fighting skills or magic powers, or even arms and legs! He’s reborn as a helpless egg, stuck in an unfamiliar forest surrounded by terrifying, hungry beasts. But eggs hatch, hatchlings grow up, and humble beginnings can lead to something great. He’ll do his best to become the strongest dragon ever, and no measly shell will get in his way!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Kao ni Denai Kashiwada-san to Kao ni Deru Oota-kun
title_japanese: 顔に出ない柏田さんと顔に出る太田君
synopsis:
Oota-kun wears his heart on his sleeve; his face reveals his every thought and emotion. In contrast, Kashiwada-san remains unreadable, as her expression never changes, no matter what happens. Bothered by Kashiwada-san's perpetual expressionlessness, Oota-kun makes it his mission to break through her calm exterior, pulling every prank and trick he can think of—from fake spiders to absurd text messages and everything in between—just to get a reaction.

As Oota-kun's relentless attempts fail to crack Kashiwada-san's perpetual poker face, their exchanges become the daily norm. Unbeknownst to him, however, his antics occasionally succeed in drawing out a subtle smile—not noticing that he has already cracked her defense since the beginning.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mayonaka Heart Tune
title_english: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
title_japanese: 真夜中ハートチューン
synopsis:
Back in middle school, Arisu Yamabuki's only solace in life was a radio show hosted by a girl named Apollo. He used to faithfully tune into the program every night until she abruptly stopped broadcasting entirely. Despite having very few clues about Apollo's identity, Yamabuki has thoroughly investigated her, which eventually led him to enroll in the newly co-ed Furin High School, hoping to find her there.

Just as Yamabuki suspected, the broadcasting club's first announcement is made by the familiar voice he admires! Upon entering the club room, however, Yamabuki realizes that his search will not be that easy. The four members—Rikka Inohana, Shinobu Uzuki, Nene Himekawa, and Iko Kirino—all sound like Apollo in different ways.

Yamabuki joins the club primarily to find Apollo, but he soon discovers that each girl aspires to pursue her own career with her voice. Seeing that there is a lot of room for improvement, Yamabuki takes it upon himself to help the girls reach their individual goals—but he never stops looking for his favorite Apollo.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yuusha no Kuzu
title_japanese: 勇者のクズ
synopsis:
Tokyo's criminal underworld has been using medical procedures known as ether augmentation to increase their own powers and influence. To counteract this threat, bounty hunters called Braves have emerged, using their own ether powers to eliminate the powerful mafiosos known as Dark Lords. Although he is a self-proclaimed first-rate Brave, Yashiro struggles to make ends meet.

One day, Yashiro helps out a young student of Shibuya's Brave Academy named Aki Jougamine. Impressed by his skill, Aki begs him to help save her friend and fellow student, Saera Kashiwagi Pendragon, from the clutches of a Dark Lord, which he reluctantly agrees to.

After assisting them, Aki, Saera, and their friend Yukine Indou insist on apprenticing with Yashiro. Despite his attempts to dissuade them from the dangers of bounty hunting, the trio believes that Yashiro is their key to becoming full-fledged Braves, leaving him to reluctantly give in. With each new threat they encounter, Yashiro will try to convince them that the three students are not cut out for bounty hunting, but they may just prove him wrong.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Fuuki Iin to Fuuzoku Katsudou
title_japanese: 風紀委員とフーゾク活動
synopsis: Responsible boy Shinji Izumi studies hard and enters a popular university. Until recently, the educational institution was considered to be only for women, and he turned out to be the only guy there. Everything would be fine, but there is one committee there that maintains order in an unusual way. The boy is forced to obey their rules. Over time, these rules develop into a hurricane of feelings and emotions. There is no escape from such a storm, and Shinji will have to make a choice.

title: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
title_english: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
title_japanese: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～
synopsis:
Within the Kingdom of Ei's opulent inner court is the thriving Maiden Court, where the empress and the four imperial consorts are chosen from five prominent clans. Among them, one pristine consort-in-training, Reirin Kou, stands out as the perfect candidate for the future empress. Her virtue and elegance are unrivaled, and she is flawless—save for her extremely sickly constitution. Compared to the court's gentle butterfly, the boorish Keigetsu Shu is like a sewer rat. Always staring at Reirin with bitter envy, Keigetsu is a disgrace to the Maiden Court.

During the night of a rare comet sighting, Keigetsu's jealousy reaches its peak, and she attempts to murder Reirin by pushing her off a balcony. Reirin is quickly saved from death, and Keigetsu is imprisoned to await her execution. Unbeknownst to all, Keigetsu has cast a spell to swap bodies with Reirin in order to steal all that belongs to her. But while Keigetsu is hindered by Reirin's frail body, Reirin fully embraces freedom and physical strength for the first time in her life, determined to live—no matter whose face she wears.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Digimon Beatbreak
title_japanese: DIGIMON BEATBREAK（デジモンビートブレイク）
synopsis:
Tomorou Tenma possesses a uniquely strong e-Pulse—the energy created by human thoughts and emotions that powers egg-shaped AI devices named Sapotama. The world's everyday life relies on the assistance of Sapotamas, but the force of Tomorou's e-Pulse often causes glitches in them. One night, a strange creature calling itself Gekkoumon emerges from his device and insists on eating Tomorou's e-Pulse.

Gekkoumon is a Digimon, a creature feeding on e-Pulse that was born from an error in Sapotamas. Some Digimon completely drain humans of their energy, leaving them in a comatose state known as Cold Heart. When Tomorou's older brother, Asuka, becomes a victim of this phenomenon, Tomorou vows to avenge him.

Tomorou meets a group of Digimon-wielders called Glowing Dawn, who hunt down rogue Digimon for bounties. Their leader, Kyou Sawashiro, explains that there might still be hope for Asuka's recovery. Although Tomorou struggles to trust these strangers, he decides to join them, as he realizes that saving his brother may not be achievable on his own.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ginga Tokkyuu Milky☆Subway
title_japanese: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ
synopsis:
Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky☆Subway—an old interplanetary train.

Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy.

Just pure momentum!

(Source: Official website, translated)

title: Mikata ga Yowasugite Hojo Mahou ni Tesshiteita Kyuutei Mahoushi, Tsuihou sarete Saikyou wo Mezasu
title_english: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
title_japanese: 味方が弱すぎて補助魔法に徹していた宮廷魔法師、追放されて最強を目指す
synopsis:
"This party doesn't need an incompetent magician who can only use supportive magic. You're fired, Alec Ygret."

Suddenly, Alec, a court magician who had joined the crown prince's party to help him conquer dungeons—was banished from the party. And not just the party, but the crown prince's harassment has banished him from the royal palace as well, and a friend from the "magic academy" approached Alec, who was at his wit's end.

"Hey, Alec. Do you want to try to conquer the dungeon with us again?"

And so, together with the friends he used to party with, Alec begins his second journey in life. This is the adventure story of a former court magician who had been abandoned.

Four years ago, the "Lasting Period," a party of four that had been called "legendary," has gradually spread its name around the world.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kore Kaite Shine
title_japanese: これ描いて死ね
synopsis:
Ai Yasumi, a first-year high school student living on Izu-Oshima, loves manga more than anything. When she learns that her long-admired, yet long-inactive, favorite manga artist Hoshi no Rei will be exhibiting at COMITIA, she sets off on a journey to Tokyo.

What she doesn't expect, however, is that a fateful encounter at the event will change her life forever.

"How does one become a manga artist?" Ai steps into the world of manga creation—a path she thought she understood, yet knows so little about. This is the story of a girl taking her first steps down the road to becoming a mangaka.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Koisuru One Piece
title_japanese: 恋するワンピース
synopsis:
The premise of this gag manga spinoff is about three high school students: a young male student, his girlfriend and a third wheel who is a One Piece fanatic. Their names are similar to the Straw Hat Pirates and the group form a fan club dedicated to One Piece.

(Source: One Piece Wiki)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX - Beginning
title_japanese: 機動戦士 Gundam GQuuuuuuX -Beginning-
synopsis:
Amate Yuzuriha is a high-school student living peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. When she meets a war refugee named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle.

Under the entry name "Machu," she throws herself into fierce battle day after day, piloting the GQuuuuuuX. Then an unidentified Gundam mobile suit pursued by both the space force and the police appears before her, along with its pilot, a boy named Shuji.

(Source: Official site)

title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 4th Season
title_english: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4
title_japanese: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 4th season
synopsis:
In the deadly battle at the Watergate City of Priestella, Subaru and his allies barely emerged victorious—but their triumph came at a great cost. Through the "Authority of Gluttony," Rem was put into suspended animation, while Crusch's memories and even Julius’s name were devoured. As he searches for a way to save them, Subaru learns of the "Sage" Shaula—an all-seeing being said to possess every form of knowledge. His next destination is the Pleiades Watchtower, home to the Sage, the farthest tower standing in the vast, uncharted desert known as the Auguria Dunes—a place so perilous that even the mightiest "Sword Saint," Reinhard, failed to conquer it. The fury of nature, unknown magical beasts, and unimaginable dangers lie ahead. Together with his friends, Subaru embarks on a life-risking journey to reclaim what was lost.

(Source: Kadokawa, edited)

title: Dr. Stone: Science Future Part 2
title_japanese: Dr.STONE SCIENCE FUTURE 第2クール
synopsis:
After a strategic maneuver, Senkuu Ishigami's team stalls Dr. Xeno's more scientifically advanced forces. A ceasefire between the two factions allows for the establishment of Corn City in North America, a hope for a future thriving population. Meanwhile, Senkuu and some of his teammates rush toward the Amazon in South America—the epicenter of the petrification beam's impact—to create Superalloy City and progress their spaceship project.

With dangerous enemies still pursuing Senkuu and his companions, it is a race against time to reach the heart of the dense Amazon. As unexpected allies and scientific creations further fuel this leg of their journey, Senkuu is closer than ever to finally uncovering the mystery behind the petrification phenomenon.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ao no Hako Season 2
title_japanese: アオのハコ Season2
synopsis: Second season of Ao no Hako.

title: Douse, Koishite Shimaunda. 2nd Season
title_english: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You. Season 2
title_japanese: どうせ、恋してしまうんだ。第2期
synopsis:
As seasons have passed, Mizuho Nishino's adolescence has been full of ups and downs. With Christmas approaching, she intends to celebrate the special event with all of her four childhood friends: Kizuki Hazawa, Shin Kashiwagi, Airu Izumi, and Shuugo Hoshikawa. However, Kizuki makes the first move when he declares that he wants to spend the time alone with Mizuho. Although hesitant at first, Mizuho ends up confiding in him and declares Kizuki to be her boyfriend!

The news about Mizuho and Kizuki spreads quickly and brings forth Shin and Airu, who have had a difficult time accepting their feelings for the one they love. With the friend group faced with a delicate situation they have never confronted before, only time will tell if the new romance and old friendships can survive.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Medalist 2nd Season
title_japanese: メダリスト 第2期
synopsis:
Ever since the novice coach Tsukasa Akeuraji took Inori Yuitsuka under his mentorship, she has improved her figure skating at a fast pace. After passing a qualifying badge test, she earns a spot to compete in the upcoming Chubu Block Tournament, where only five of the 15 competitors can move forward to the next stage—the prestigious All-Japan Novice Tournament. However, earning a slot will not be easy for Inori: most of her rivals have already experienced trying their luck in the competition.

The stakes are high as the competition begins, and one by one, each of the competitors strive to perform their very best in front of the big crowd. Moreover, the current figure skating generation's prodigy, Hikaru Kamisaki, is not competing in this block, which raises everyone's determination to qualify. That includes Inori, who must beat the odds if she wants to keep her promise to reach Hikaru and represent Japan in the Olympics with Tsukasa.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun 2 Part 2
title_japanese: 地縛少年花子くん2 後編
synopsis:
Due to frequent misadventures with the supernatural and her hectic school life, Nene Yashiro can barely catch a break until Kamome Academy's annual sleepover event comes around. Nene is excited to blow off some steam with her best friend Aoi Akane and the rest of her class at the get-together. Unbeknownst to her, the sleepover falls on the same date as Urabon, when the line between the dead and the living gets distorted, allowing wicked spirits to come out to the surface.

When an evil ghost is about to attack her, Nene is rescued by a mysterious figure: Shinigami, the Sixth Wonder that can trap souls using his flute. In that moment, Shinigami takes notice of Aoi and abducts her to use her as a sacrifice that will close the barrier for good. Joined by Hanako-kun and Akane Aoi, Nene must embark on a journey into the deepest confines of the world of the dead to save her best friend before it is too late.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
title_english: You Can't Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!
title_japanese: 幼馴染とはラブコメにならない
synopsis:
As a romantic comedy enthusiast, Yonosuke "Eiyuu" Sakai enjoys the stories about childhood friends the most. But he solemnly believes that the flawless, loving childhood friends from his stories exist only in fiction. Though he has two childhood friends of his own—Shio Minamo and Akari Hiodoshi—Eiyuu has never seen either one of them as anything more.

However, now that they are all in high school together, the beauty of the two girls begins to catch Eiyuu's eye. As his interest subtly grows, the girls start to make advances toward him regardless of time or place—but only time will tell if Eiyuu will ever overcome his denial and finally see the girls in another light.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ponkotsu Fuuki Iin to Skirt-take ga Futekisetsu na JK no Hanashi
title_english: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
title_japanese: ポンコツ風紀委員とスカート丈が不適切なJKの話
synopsis:
Stylish high school student Poem Kohinata enjoys expressing herself by dying her hair blond and wearing short skirts to school. Her appearance often gets her in trouble with the dedicated but strict class monitor, Tougo Sakuradaimon, who sees Poem's attire as a violation of the school rules. While taking supplemental lessons, Poem is surprised to discover Sakuradaimon—despite his dedication as a class monitor—is also taking part due to a severe lack of academic prowess.

However, the lessons spark a change in their relationship: Poem and Sakuradaimon both admit they have misjudged each other, bringing the two closer. Their exchanges become the daily norm, and Poem struggles to contain her emotions as Sakuradaimon expresses sincere affection for her. With her friends and other eccentric committee representatives thrown into the mix, the two begin to enjoy their school days more, even as they continue bickering about the rules.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Haru no Mai
title_english: Agents of the Four Seasons: Dance of Spring
title_japanese: 春夏秋冬代行者 春の舞
synopsis:
For centuries, the task of bringing the seasons has been carried out by the Agents of the Four Seasons, individuals whose god-like powers make them an easy target for covetous groups. One such group, the Rebels, orchestrates an attack on the Agents. To save the others, the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayou, allows herself to be captured and disappears from the face of the Earth. Despite the lack of help, even from her own village, Hinagiku's guard, Sakura Himedaka, believes she is still alive somewhere and refuses to give up the search.

Against all odds, Hinagiku is found 10 years later. However, the traumatic event caused a massive shift in her personality. Thanks to Sakura's encouragement, Hinagiku gets the courage to summon the season that was once lost. In order to move forward, the duo must face a past that haunts them and demons willing to destroy everything to achieve their goals.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken
title_english: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
title_japanese: スティール・ボール・ラン ジョジョの奇妙な冒険
synopsis:
In the American Old West, the world's greatest race is about to begin. Thousands line up in San Diego to travel over six thousand kilometers for a chance to win the grand prize of fifty million dollars. With the era of the horse reaching its end, contestants are allowed to use any kind of vehicle they wish. Competitors will have to endure grueling conditions, traveling up to a hundred kilometers a day through uncharted wastelands. The Steel Ball Run is truly a one-of-a-kind event.

The youthful Johnny Joestar, a crippled former horse racer, has come to San Diego to watch the start of the race. There he encounters Gyro Zeppeli, a racer with two steel balls at his waist instead of a gun. Johnny witnesses Gyro using one of his steel balls to unleash a fantastical power, compelling a man to fire his gun at himself during a duel. In the midst of the action, Johnny happens to touch the steel ball and feels a power surging through his legs, allowing him to stand up for the first time in two years. Vowing to find the secret of the steel balls, Johnny decides to compete in the race, and so begins his bizarre adventure across America on the Steel Ball Run.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tenmaku no Jaadugar
title_japanese: 天幕のジャードゥーガル
synopsis:
Eight centuries ago, in the latter days of the Islamic golden age, a young girl arrived in the Khwarazmian city of Tus. She was a slave. But she learned. Eight centuries ago, the Mongols blazed across the map, swept Khwarazm into the ash heap of history, and took all they desired from the ruins. They took the girl who learned. So begins the true story of how a "witch," wielding knowledge as her only weapon, came to hold the greatest empire the world has ever known in the palm of her hand...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi
title_japanese: カナン様はあくまでチョロい
synopsis:
Kanan is a demon who descends upon the human world with one goal: to feast on the sweetest delicacy of all—young human souls. Disguised as a high schooler, she sets her sights on her first target, an unassuming boy named Youji Kyougi. But just as she prepares to claim her meal, things take a very unexpected turn.

Instead of devouring him, Kanan ends up forming a "romantic contract" with Youji. For someone who's lived for millennia without experiencing love, navigating high school romance proves more terrifying than any hunt. Between awkward dates, hand-holding mishaps, and feelings she can't quite name, the once-proud demon finds herself flustered at every turn.

A supernatural romcom about a lovestruck demon and the boy who was supposed to be her prey—sweet, chaotic, and full of firsts.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Kingdom 6th Season
title_japanese: キングダム 第6シリーズ
synopsis:
In ancient China, during the Warring States period, a former servant named Xin rises through the ranks with a dream: to become the greatest general under the heavens. Fighting alongside King Ying Zheng of Qin—who seeks to unify China and end the chaos—Xin leads his own unit, the Fei Xin Force, onto the battlefield.

With power reclaimed from the influential Chancellor Buwei Lü, King Ying Zheng begins laying the groundwork for a new, unified legal state with the support of key allies like strategist Changping Jun and legalist Li Si.

As Qin launches a campaign to seize new territory from the state of Zhao, their advance is halted by the brilliant strategist, Li Mu. In response, Changping Jun devises a bold plan: to bypass Zhao's defenses and strike at the key city of Gyou, near Zhao's capital.

To carry out this risky maneuver, a powerful coalition army is formed—led by the tacticians Ou Sen (Wang Jian), Kan Ki (Huan Yi), and the warrior queen Yo Tan Wa (Yang Duanhe). Joining them are the next generation of Qin commanders: Xin's Fei Xin Force, Mou Ten (Meng Tian)'s Gaku Ka Unit, and Ou Hon (Wang Ben)'s Gyoku Hou Unit, each operating independently.

The fierce battle for Gyou begins, as the future of Qin's unification hangs in the balance.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Star Wars: Visions - Kyuuninme no Jedi
title_english: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi
title_japanese: スター・ウォーズ：ビジョンズ／九人目のジェダイ
synopsis: A spin-off which will expand upon The Ninth Jedi in a longer format.

title: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisankei Majutsu de Na mo Naki Mura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
title_english: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
title_japanese: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis:
Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he's considered a child prodigy...until he displays the "Production Magic" skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his "worthless" magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
title_english: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
title_japanese: 生徒会にも穴はある！
synopsis:
Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary.

Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Umayuru: Pretty Gray
title_japanese: うまゆるぷりてぃーぐれい
synopsis:
A short animation spin-off series that focuses on various ashen-haired Umamusume. 

(Source: Uma Musume Pretty Wiki)

title: Immoral Game Master The Animation
title_japanese: 淫モラル・ゲームマスター THE ANIMATION

title: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omouna" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai
title_japanese: 「お前ごときが魔王に勝てると思うな」と勇者パーティを追放されたので、王都で気ままに暮らしたい
synopsis:
Chosen by the Church's god, Origin, a young country girl named Flum Apricot is enlisted in the hero's party and expected to fight demons. However, her one innate skill, Reversal, has no practical use, and the party's sage, Jean Inteige, treats her as a burden, eventually selling her off to a slave dealer.

In the slave dealer's dark dungeon, all hope seems lost. But in a moment of desperation, Flum discovers that her skill actually turns the negative energy of cursed weapons into power, which helps her slay the slave owner and escape with another captured girl, Milkit. Now equipped with the means to fight and survive, Flum embraces the career of an adventurer and aims to lead a happy life with Milkit, away from the grim machinations of the Church.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: I Byeol-e Pil-yohan
title_japanese: 이 별에 필요한
synopsis:
Nan-young is a scientist whose astronaut mom failed to return to Earth when things went awry during her Mars probe. Nan-young has always dreamed of exploring space too and longs to go to Mars in hopes of finding a trace of her mom.

Her dream comes true when she is selected as one of the astronauts for a Mars probe project. Before she blasts off though, she meets Jay, a musician who also fixes retro sound instruments. It's all thanks to an old turntable that Nan-young inherited from her mom.

(Source: Netflix, edited)

title: Boku no Risou no Isekai Seikatsu
title_japanese: ボクの理想の異世界生活

title: Ao Ashi Season 2
title_japanese: アオアシ Season2
synopsis: Second season of Ao Ashi.

title: Shiguang Dailiren III
title_japanese: 时光代理人III
synopsis:
After the Li Tianchen incident came to a close, Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial peace. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again drew everyone into a crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening of her superpowers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case, and Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seem to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao from a mysterious organization begins his operation, and the intervention of Yingdu police officer Jae further complicates this pursuit of the truth...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Lupin the IIIrd: Zenigata to Futari no Lupin
title_english: Lupin the IIIrd: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
title_japanese: LUPIN THE IIIRD 銭形と2人のルパン
synopsis: Prequel to Lupin the IIIrd the Movie: Fujimi no Ketsuzoku.

title: Tonari no Kanojo
title_japanese: トナリノカノジョ
synopsis:
Kyoko and Suji are neighbors. They grew up together, shared bitterness and joy together, and are already more than friends to each other. But the boy is not sure of his desires and does not dare to make the first step.

One day the friends foolishly quarrel. Kyoko disappeared for a few days, and worried about her absence, Suji received a videotape in the mail. In the video, the unknown man showed Kyoko how to build a strong relationship with a girl. The boy turns the video on as an insecure young man, but turns it off as a man who knows what he wants.

title: Yogoreta Kanojo
title_japanese: ヨゴレタカノジョ
synopsis: Azuma Kyouko and her boyfriend are studying with a tutor, and then boyfriend has to go. Kyouko decides to have fun with the tutor, but it's for a sinister purpose...

title: Tu Bian Yingxiong X Concept Movie
title_english: To Be Hero X Concept Movie
title_japanese: 「TO BE HERO X」コンセプトムービー
synopsis: Concept movie that features animation that is unique and not present in the main series.

title: 29-sai Dokushin Chuuken Boukensha no Nichijou
title_english: An Adventurer's Daily Grind at Age 29
title_japanese: 29歳独身中堅冒険者の日常
synopsis:
Hajime Shinonome is a 29-year-old seasoned adventurer who has long stepped away from the glory of youthful ambition, instead content with his steady life in Komai Village. During a dungeon expedition, he rescues a young girl named Rirui, who was abandoned and nearly consumed by a slime. Driven by memories of a similarly unforgiving past, Hajime takes her under his care. But as Rirui begins to reveal unexpected abilities while adapting to the rhythm of village life, Hajime finds that their shared existence may prove to be more consequential than any other quest he has ever attempted.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki
title_japanese: うるわしの宵の月
synopsis:
Every time Yoi Takiguchi so much as lets out a sigh, her female classmates squeal in admiration and awe. She has been dubbed the school's "prince" by virtue of her boyishly attractive appearance and casual disposition. However, she chooses to be indifferent toward the attention she receives and spends her days normally—that is, until the school's other prince, Kohaku Ichimura, waltzes into her life and calls her beautiful.

Kohaku is nothing like a prince—he acts thoughtlessly and does as he pleases. But when he compliments her, Yoi feels flustered, and the way he looks at her gets her all nervous. He is the first boy to acknowledge her as a girl, and her attempts to distance herself prove futile as he seems to have set his sights on her. While Yoi keeps telling herself that it is nothing serious, even she cannot completely ignore the stir Kohaku causes in her heart.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Hokori)!
title_english: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
title_japanese: ヒロイン?聖女?いいえ、オールワークスメイドです(誇)!
synopsis:
"I will become the world's most wonderful maid!" With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count's family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic.

Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku.
title_english: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
title_japanese: 自称悪役令嬢な婚約者の観察記録。
synopsis:
Cecil Glo Alphasta's life is always utterly unchallenging. The heir to his father's kingdom, he is known as a genius in everything he accomplishes. However, nothing interests him until he meets his fiancée, Bertia Ibil Noches.

On their first meeting, Bertia tells him they are inside an otome game, and she has the role of the villainess who interferes with the relationship between Cecil and the heroine. Although she proclaims she will fulfill her duty as a "wicked flower," Bertia's actions end up causing more good than harm. Intrigued by her behavior and deeds, Cecil decides he wants Bertia around and helps her behind the scenes. But with a fiancée like Bertia, the heroine might not be needed anymore.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka??
title_english: Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
title_japanese: アンドロイドは経験人数に入りますか??
synopsis:
Office Lady Tsuda Akane, age 28, seems like she's got it all together. Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! Well, maybe not good, because the beautiful lady android that arrives is a horny hottie. Akane's about to get more service than she expected!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Dekichau made Kon
title_english: Marry Me, Let's Have a Baby!
title_japanese: デキちゃうまで婚
synopsis:
Marry me, but only if we have a baby!

At a speed-dating event, Taika hits it off with a woman named Ayano, a doctor who's eager to have children. However, just as the matching couples are about to be announced, he panics and makes a break for it when his fears about his erectile dysfunction begin to surface... Later, at an appointment for his condition, Taika is shocked to discover that his doctor is none other than Ayano herself! On top of that, he realizes that when he's with Ayano, his erectile dysfunction disappears!

This is a story about two people who decide to enter into a secret contractual marriage with one goal, to have a child in less than a year!

(Source: Official Website)

title: Wiheomhan Pyeonuijeom
title_japanese: 위험한 편의점
synopsis:
College student Yeo Euijoon has little going for him. To pay his living expenses, tuition, and even his comatose brother's hospital bills, Euijoon spends his nights working at a convenience store. However, it is by no means an ordinary store; it is situated in a dangerous neighborhood, and all sorts of crooks and gangsters tend to come by and stir up trouble. Still, Euijoon never loses his lively spark and greets everyone with a smile.

Although most thugs pick fights with Euijoon, one tall, handsome, and well-dressed returning customer makes Euijoon all flustered. Beom Geonwoo is a man of very few words, slightly older than Euijoon, and certainly not a stranger to blood and violence. But Euijoon thinks him sweet, and when Geonwoo by chance catches Euijoon in a sticky personal situation, they start a casual fling that may just turn life-changing for the both of them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Let's Play: Quest-darake no My Life
title_japanese: Let's Play クエストだらけのマイライフ
synopsis:
Through her college years, Sam Young devoted hours upon hours to developing her adventure puzzle game, Ruminate. Despite being very ill as a child, Sam aspires to become a true game developer. But when her favorite gaming streamer, Marshall Law, tests the game, he horribly misunderstands it and declares it the worst game he has ever played. As a result, his fans bombard Sam's game with negative reviews, jeopardizing her dreams.

To make matters worse, Marshall moves in as Sam's new neighbor, unaware that she is the developer he so harshly criticized. Although he appears caring and kind, she struggles to befriend him. Before she can develop her second game, Evermake, Sam must first figure out a way to repair her ruined reputation.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka.
title_japanese: 綺麗にしてもらえますか。
synopsis:
In the quaint seaside resort town of Atami lies Kinme Cleaning, a laundry service run by Wakana Kinme. Despite having no memory of her life before moving there, Wakana has spent the past two years quietly building a new life among the locals. She tends to garments entrusted to her with gentle hands and meticulous care, each carrying memories far more fragile than the fabric itself.

Wakana becomes a familiar presence in the town as she shares small yet precious moments with everyone. The clothing she cleans tells stories of their owners' everyday lives, allowing her to safeguard their memories even as her own remain out of reach. As she continues to wash away stains both physical and psychological, her life becomes a gentle testament to the comfort found in ordinary moments—and to the idea that even without a past, she can still belong.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Netorareta Bakunyuu Tsuma-tachi
title_japanese: 寝取られた爆乳妻たち
synopsis: Masaru, the nephew of Hitomi's husband, comes to live with them after his parents go away. Hitomi and her husband were in an arranged marriage, and things are not going very well with them. Hitomi wants to spend time with her husband, whose job takes him far away. Masaru decides to comfort Hitomi, and then things happen.

title: Love Me: Kakurenbo The Animation
title_english: Love Me: Hide & Seek The Animation
title_japanese: らぶみー『かくれんぼ』 THE ANIMATION

title: Oni no Hanayome
title_japanese: 鬼の花嫁
synopsis:
"You're the bride I've been searching for all this time."

A Japanese-style ayakashi Cinderella story! The ayakashi and humans coexist in harmony. The ayakashi, having superior abilities and beautiful appearances, sometimes find their partner among human women, making them their "bride." The bride, in exchange for bringing prosperity, receives absolute love from the ayakashi.

Yuzu is constantly compared to her sister, a bride of a demon fox, and is resented by her family every day. One day, when Yuzu just couldn't take things anymore, a man appeared before her on a bridge. This man is the most beautiful man Yuzu has ever seen... and he's calling her his wife?!

"Just be quiet and let me hold you." The most powerful, "cold-hearted" ayakashi is pouring his heart out for Yuzu?!

(Source: MangaPlaza, edited)

title: Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru? Season 2
title_english: The Beginning After the End Season 2
title_japanese: 最強の王様、二度目の人生は何をする? Season2
synopsis:
After being granted a second life, now-teenage Arthur Leywin—an unparalleled, ruthless king in his previous life—has finally become an adventurer with the help of his mentor, Jasmine Flamesworth. Although he is still far from his ultimate goal of becoming more powerful than in his past life, Arthur demonstrates remarkable skill in adventuring, exceeding everyone's expectations.

Meanwhile, Arthur's elven friend and Elenoir Kingdom's princess, Tessia Eralith, has also started adventuring. Due to the prolonged hostility between humans and elves, her duty is to spread goodwill and create friendly relations with human kingdoms. However, as a mysterious group threatens to harm the races' fragile relationship, both Arthur and Tessia soon find themselves becoming pivotal parts of a larger change for the better.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Aishiteru Game wo Owarasetai
title_english: I Want to End This Love Game
title_japanese: 愛してるゲームを終わらせたい
synopsis:
For four years, childhood friends Yukiya Asagi and Miku Sakura have been playing something they call the "love game." The rules are simple: they declare love to one another, and the first one to blush loses. Yukiya is set on winning against Miku, going as far as to read her favorite manga and change his appearance, but no matter what he does, Miku always seems to be one step ahead.

Now in high school, Yukiya and Miku have slightly changed the rules of the game. They can do just about anything to fluster the other party and force them to admit defeat—but it usually ends in a tie. Their true feelings could not be more apparent—yet the stubborn pair refuses to stop the game, even if they can barely control their growing affection.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Pyramid Game
title_japanese: 피라미드 게임
synopsis:
Every Thursday afternoon, once a month, students at Love High cast their votes in a popularity poll. The result? A brutal ranking system that determines the entire social hierarchy of the school. After starting at the bottom, can new transfer student Suji make her way to the top of the pyramid? Or will she topple the game altogether?

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Isekai Quartet 3
title_japanese: 異世界かるてっと3
synopsis: Third season of Isekai Quartet.

title: Maou no Musume wa Yasashisugiru!!
title_english: The Demon King's Daughter Is Too Kind!!
title_japanese: 魔王の娘は優しすぎる!!
synopsis:
The Demon King Ahriman once led his armies across the world with unquestioned authority; yet his campaigns come to an abrupt halt for an unexpected reason: his daughter, Doux, is far too kind. While she was born in the demon realm, she seems otherwise incapable of being cruel, as she regularly befriends enemies, comforts monsters, and treats even humans with warmth, leaving her father uncertain how a child like her could ever inherit the throne.

In a vain attempt to find a solution to this insurmountable flaw, Ahriman entrusts his loyal aide Jahi with the task of reforming Doux's disposition. Through a series of lessons and trials meant to cultivate ruthlessness, Jahi attempts to guide the young princess toward becoming a proper demon. Each effort, however, produces the opposite result, as Doux's sincerity disarms hostility and spreads unexpected goodwill wherever she goes, proving that changing the princess may be far more difficult than conquering any continent.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Goumon Baito-kun no Nichijou
title_english: The Daily Life of a Part-time Torturer
title_japanese: 拷問バイトくんの日常
synopsis:
This is a world where killing and torture are legalized. Sero, a part-time worker at a torture company, enjoys torturing people every day with his senior colleague, Siu. With the addition of new part-timers Mike and Hugh, fun torture life continues!

The gap between the at-home, easy-going workplace and the gruesome torture is bound to attract a lot of addicts! 

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title: Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II
title_english: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2
title_japanese: 片田舎のおっさん、剣聖になるII
synopsis: Second season of Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Otona e no Kaidan
title_english: Kaguya-sama: Love Is War - Stairway to Adulthood
title_japanese: かぐや様は告らせたい 大人への階段
synopsis:
Years after graduating from high school, Kaguya Shinomiya finds her old photo album and reminisces about when she was a part of Shuuchiin Academy's student council. At the time, Kaguya had just started dating the president Miyuki Shirogane, and the two were hopelessly in love. With each wholesome and silly memory from their past, Kaguya is filled with bliss.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mujin Eki The Animation
title_japanese: 無人駅 The Animation

title: Towa no Yuugure
title_english: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
title_japanese: 永久のユウグレ
synopsis:
In an era trembling on the edge of an AI revolution, Towasa Oumagi stands out as a prodigy.
