One does not need dance to live.

In 1374, during the turbulent age when the Northern and Southern Courts were locked in conflict, the Northern Court's shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, was becoming an increasingly dominant force.

Born the son of Kanami, head of the Kanze troupe of sarugaku performers, Oniyasha drifts through his days with a hazy question lodged in his heart: Why do people dance? His spirit remains clouded, until the day he encounters a dance that is truly "good."

Curious, sensitive, and strikingly beautiful, the boy meets people, laughs, cries, confronts his own weaknesses, and slowly begins to shape a new form of dance for a world steeped in impermanence.

(Source: Shochiku)

title: Serenade (2026)
title_japanese: セレナーデ
synopsis: Music video for the song Serenade by natori. The song was used as the ending theme of the anime [Oshi no Ko] 3rd Season.

title: Nippon Sangoku
title_english: Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
title_japanese: 日本三國
synopsis:
The pinnacle of modern civilization known as Japan is now long forgotten. Ravaged by civil war and technological collapse, Japan has regressed into a post-Meiji era society and is now divided into three imperial territories known as Yamato, Buo, and Seii.

However, Aoteru Misumi, a 15-year-old literature enthusiast, dreams to bring back the culture and technology that once made the pride of his country. Although unwilling to turn his theoretical knowledge into concrete action at first, a tragic turn of events drives Aoteru to head to Osaka in hopes of enlisting in the army and eventually uniting the country under his own banner.

Osaka—once one of the three jewels of Kansai—has become a crime-ridden city where Aoteru almost loses his life. Luckily, he encounters a fellow ambitious young man named Yoshitsune Asama who pursues the same dream. With Aoteru's strategic prowess and Yoshitsune's masterful swordsmanship, the two now embark on a journey to restore the former glory of Japan.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Megami "Isekai Tensei Nani ni Naritai desu ka" Ore "Yuusha no Rokkotsu de"
title_japanese: 女神「異世界転生何になりたいですか」俺「勇者の肋骨で」
synopsis:
The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications.

The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onna no Ko wo Ippai Click Shimaasu
title_english: Now That I Can Control Reality with a Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away on the Girls!
title_japanese: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす
synopsis:
What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
title_japanese: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
synopsis:
Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.

Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Evangelion: Housou 30-shuunen Kinen Tokubetsu Kougyou
title_japanese: エヴァンゲリオン 放送30周年記念特別興行
synopsis:
A new short animation for the Evangelion series that debuted at the "EVANGELION:30+; 30th ANN/VERSARY OF EVANGELION" fes. in Yokohama Arena.

Two Asuka Langleys from different timelines host a comedy stage show to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Evangelion franchise and re-enact key scenes from the TV series and the films, hoping for Asuka Langley Souryuu to find the perfect ending to her story arc.

(Source: ANN)

title: Ray (Chou Kaguya-hime! Version)
title_japanese: ray 超かぐや姫！Version
synopsis: Music video for the song Ray (Chou Kaguya-hime! Version) by Kaguya (CV: Yuuko Natsuyoshi) and Yachiyo Runami (CV: Saori Hayami). The song was used as the ending theme of the anime Chou Kaguya-hime!

title: Yani Neko
title_japanese: ヤニねこ
synopsis:
Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.
title_english: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
title_japanese: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
synopsis:
Deep within the forest, a cozy and rather cluttered cottage sits on the lakeshore, housing a mysterious, feared witch. In truth, she is a lovely young woman named Rose, who has learned the art of potion-making from her wise grandmother. Rose cherishes her tucked-away life, yet there is a longing in her heart—for a handsome knight she once saw, Sir Harij Azm.

For four years, Rose's feelings for Harij have lingered, but she can never act on them; witches live outside of human affairs and belong to no country or man. So, when Harij suddenly appears on her doorstep looking for a love potion, Rose is both surprised and heartbroken. Although another woman has captured the noble knight's heart, Rose decides to help him. But before crafting the potion, Rose sends Harij on a series of ridiculous quests for each ingredient, hoping to delay the inevitable and savor their fleeting time together.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Thunder 3
title_japanese: サンダー3
synopsis:
Three ordinary schoolboys come into possession of a DVD that supposedly opens a gateway to a parallel universe, but when their backs are turned Pyontarou's little sister Futaba passes through and gets kidnapped by the aliens that have overrun that version of Earth! Discovering that their cartoonish bodies make them supermen in the hyper-realistic parallel universe, the boys set out to rescue Futaba.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
title_english: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
title_japanese: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
synopsis:
Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points!

With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!

(Source: Shochiku)

title: Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san
title_japanese: うしろの正面カムイさん
synopsis:
Shizuka is a normal high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. Due to her peculiar tendency to attract ghosts, she works as an assistant to Kamui, a famous psychic. Kamui takes pride in his top-notch psychic abilities, but the way he exorcises ghosts is rather unusual!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hyakki Yakoushou
title_japanese: 百鬼夜行抄
synopsis:
Ritsu inherited his sixth sense from his grandfather, along with a demon guardian named Blue Storm. Strange things just seem to happen around these two, and it's left to them to get to the bottom of all these mysterious events. Each story is independent but features recurring characters you'll come to know and appreciate as they, each in their own way, try to deal with things 'not of this world'.

(Source: MU)

title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
title_japanese: 天は赤い河のほとり
synopsis:
Yuri, a pretty Japanese girl, is ecstatic after passing her college entrance exam and having her first kiss with her childhood friend-turned boyfriend. However, her luck soon changes. She starts to notice that water becomes agitated whenever she goes near it. One night, hands appear out of a puddle on the street and drag her into the water! Transported to an ancient village in the Middle East, she is then captured by armed troops and taken to the Queen's palace for a human sacrifice.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai: Omoi wo Hasemashita
title_english: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter - I Let My Thoughts Wander
title_japanese: 異世界の沙汰は社畜次第 OVA 「思いを馳せました」
synopsis: Special episode included in Blu-ray & DVD volume 3 of Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai.

title: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku
title_english: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
title_japanese: 落第賢者の学院無双～二度目の転生、Sランクチート魔術師冒険録～
synopsis:
The Sage of Wind, Ephtal is a reincarnated human, coming from modern Earth. Reincarnated in a new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish.

But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic!

However, in a surprising turn of events, he discovers that magic has terribly declined. In this era where powerful spells are a rarity, his talentless self is now completely unmatched! From the depths of powerlessness to the peak of power, the talentless but peerless mage's journey to the top starts now!

(Source: Manga UP!, edited)

title: Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru
title_japanese: ダークサモナーとデキている
synopsis:
Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human who uses demonic powers, is the newest addition to the party of the uptight priest Roni. Everyone expected the two to dislike each other and to have nothing to do with each other. But to their surprise, on their first day together as an adventuring party, they had a one-night stand...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Perfect Addiction
title_japanese: パーフェクトアディクション
synopsis:
Akihito is a college student obsessed with good looks and carnal pleasure, but he can’t stand the handsome-yet-aloof Sae. Things come to a head when Akihito is shot down at a singles mixer by a girl who’s set her romantic sights on Sae. Furious, he follows Sae to the hotel district where he learns Sae’s secret: he’s gay, and he’s having trouble enjoying himself in the bedroom. Breaking through Sae’s mental barriers is exactly the sexy challenge Akihito needed. It awakens something in them both. Will they ever be able to control themselves again?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Todo no Tsumari
title_japanese: とどの妻り

title: "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu
title_english: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
title_japanese: 『きみを愛する気はない』と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
synopsis:
An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Dandelion
title_japanese: だんでらいおん
synopsis:
Set within the Send-Off Department of the Japanese Angel Federation, Dandelion follows "Angels" Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane as they scramble to track down Earthbound spirits—souls unable to move on and find peace—and gently guide them to pass on.

The angels find themselves struggling to meet their daily tasks. However, Tetsuo Tanba and his leader, Misaki Kurogane, who make up the 21st Division's Dandelion Clan, chose to take things at their own pace: instead of rushing through cases, they take time with each spirit, listening to their regrets and helping them resolve what's holding them back. 

One day, they encounter the Earthbound spirit of an elderly man who is running at full speed, trying desperately to escape.

(Source: Netflix)

title: Kyonyuu ga Futari Inai to Bokki Shinai Otto no Tame ni Tomodachi wo Tsuretekita Tsuma
title_japanese: 巨乳が2人いないと勃起しない夫のために友達を連れてきた妻
synopsis: Newlywed couple Yuuto and Sae enjoy their honeymoon phase but Yuuto suddenly can't get aroused anymore due to his fetish for harems. Sae agonizes then asks her big-breasted friend Emi for help. Yuuto hesitates at the wife-approved threesome but when faced with Emi he loses control, turning the bedroom into a harem paradise.

title: Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?
title_english: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
title_japanese: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？
synopsis:
Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Tank Chair
title_japanese: TANK CHAIR-戦車椅子-
synopsis:
Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car wo Shoukan shimashita
title_english: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
title_japanese: 捨てられ聖女の異世界ごはん旅 隠れスキルでキャンピングカーを召喚しました
synopsis:
Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint.

However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, [Survival], as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savors gourmet cuisine to her heart's content...

Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...?

(Source: MU)

title: Kanata kara
title_japanese: 彼方から
synopsis:
Noriko Tachiki has dreamt of a beautiful fantasy land for some time, though her friends think it is only her imagination. One day, on her way home, Noriko stumbles upon a bomb disguised as a paper bag that explodes right in front of her. However, instead of dying, she is transported to a mysterious forest full of strange plants and creatures.

As she begins navigating through the woods, Noriko is suddenly attacked by a giant, worm-like monster. Fortunately, she is saved by Izark Kia Tarj, a swordsman who does not speak her language. Lacking the strength to survive on her own, Noriko decides to follow her stoic savior, taking the opportunity to learn the foreign land's language and be more useful to Izark.

Unbeknownst to her, Noriko is a crucial piece of an ancient prophecy. She is "The Awakening"—a being destined to unleash the greatest evil known as the "Sky Demon." With influential people plotting to capture Noriko for her supposed powers, both she and Izark must fend for themselves and overcome a future laced with chaos.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
title_english: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
title_japanese: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
synopsis:
Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.

However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.

Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Vertex Force
title_japanese: バーテックスフォース
synopsis:
Akira Toudou, a high schooler living in northern Okinawa, lives peacefully with his mother and his older sister, Haruka. However, behind their peaceful life lies a secret passed down through their family: Haruka has inherited a mysterious power from their father, known only as "Engine," and she has lived her life hiding this power from others. Akira, however, inherited nothing. He harbors an inferiority complex due to his own weakness.

Then, strange events began to occur all over the world. What is the purpose of the unknown enemy closing in on Akira and his friends? Now, with the fate of the universe at stake, a brother who has nothing and a sister who has everything must find out what they can really do together.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Nuki Nuki Zupposism
title_japanese: ヌきヌき ずっぽしイズム

title: Hanazakari no Kimitachi e 2nd Season
title_japanese: 花ざかりの君たちへ 第2期
synopsis: Second season of Hanazakari no Kimitachi e.

title: Ranma ½ (2024) 3rd Season
title_japanese: らんま1/2 第3期
synopsis: Third season of Ranma ½ (2024).

title: Mebius Dust
title_japanese: メビウス・ダスト
synopsis:
10 years after a mysterious meteorite crashes to Earth, people called "Rams Carriers" develop superhuman abilities called "Rams". However, those who develop these special abilities can only survive in the presence of the "Mebius Dust" released by a giant crystal, and so they are forbidden from leaving the town of Shinkatsushika.

Within Shinkatsushika, Rams Carrier children use their Rams to play a territory-conquering game to alleviate their boredom at being unable to leave town. High school student Araki along with his younger sister, Stella, and his childhood friend, Olga, form a team called "Polis Hopper" and throw themselves into the game. Their destinies begin to change when Professor Yuda, a researcher who studies Rams, asks them to participate in a certain experiment...

(Source: Official Site)

synopsis:
This is a story from a certain twisted world.
Player Name: Yuki. Occupation: professional death-game player.
Having overcome The Wall of Thirty — the jinx that causes a player's survival rate to plummet — Yuki keeps walking forward.
In a game where death is always within reach, her next challenge is a remote island cut off from the world. Eight players have been gathered there, and among them are veterans Yuki already knows.
The game: Cloudy Beach.
Beyond the wall lie only those who have crossed it. Today, as always, she plays death games to put food on the table.

(Source: Kadokawa)

title_english: You and I Are Polar Opposites Season 2
title_japanese: 正反対な君と僕 第2期
synopsis:
Six months have passed since the polar opposite classmates Miyu Suzuki and Yuusuke Tani started dating. Through spending time together along with their friends from school, the two have been happier than ever. As the year nears its end, the new couple plans to celebrate Christmas and the New Year together, making memories for years to come.

Meanwhile, Miyu and Yuusuke's friends Shuuji Taira and Kentarou Yamada are puzzled by their own situations. Due to his bad experiences in middle school, Taira still overthinks everything around him, especially after his classmate Shino Azuma began giving him more attention. Simultaneously, the usually energetic and outspoken Yamada finds it difficult to find the perfect time to confess his feelings to his shy schoolmate Natsumi Nishi. Despite everyone's differences, they continue enjoying their adolescence together and find their own ways to turn the winter break into a cherished memory.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Migawari Reijou wo Sukutta no wa Reikoku Mujihi na Koori no Ouji no Ai deshita
title_english: Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace
title_japanese: 身代わり令嬢を救ったのは冷酷無慈悲な氷の王子の愛でした
synopsis:
As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: The Ribbon Hero
title_japanese: THE RIBBON HERO リボンヒーロー
synopsis:
Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as "Nergal," she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland.

Though burdened by her past, she begins to find a glimmer of hope as she encounters the kindness of the people there. But as if to sneer at her peaceful new life, the calamity Nergal appears once more. The very despair that once reduced her homeland to ashes now threatens to steal the light from this land as well.

"I won't lose anything ever again. And I won't let anyone else lose anything either." Brushing away her tears of sorrow, the girl takes up her sword. This is the story of a lone hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy her fate.

(Source: Netflix)

title: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita
title_japanese: 世界最強の魔女、始めました
synopsis:
When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kanojo no Tomodachi
title_japanese: 彼女の友達
synopsis:
Takeru Hidaka is an ambitious high school student aiming for medical school. He has just started dating his first girlfriend, Kaori Koga, and to everyone else, their relationship seems perfectly harmonious.

However, that peace is threatened when Kaori's best friend, Tomoko Yoshioka, begins to flirt with and seduce Takeru. Caught between loyalty to his girlfriend and Tomoko's advances, Takeru falls into a double life and a complicated affair. Now, he must navigate a web of lies that puts both his academic future and his emotional connections at risk, all while the constant threat of his secret being exposed looms over him.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Hitozukiai ga Nigate na Miboujin no Yukionna-san to Noroi no Yubiwa
title_english: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
title_japanese: 人付き合いが苦手な未亡人の雪女さんと呪いの指輪
synopsis:
In a world where many different species coexist, Satoru Takahashi inherits his father's youkai-exclusive apartment complex after he passes away. One day, Takahashi meets and instantly becomes attracted to a yuki-onna, or snow woman, named Yukino. Although they initially get along, an argument drives the two apart.

While pondering how to fix their situation, Takahashi finds a strange ring inside a mysterious box. The included description states that if one directs their desires at a youkai who is within view of the ring, it is possible to control their mind. Takahashi remains skeptical until, during another desperate attempt to talk to Yukino, he shows the ring to her and witnesses its potential. With immense power at his fingertips, Takahashi must decide whether to use the ring to restore his relationship with Yukino or to fulfill his primitive desires.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi
title_english: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
title_japanese: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士
synopsis:
At the center of a continent made up of eight kingdoms lies the Kingdom of Marronnier. Leading the nation is the female general Baribara, who has seven sons, each with a personality all his own.

Sleepy, benevolent, sensitive to heat, sensitive to cold, gifted with animals, proud of his swordsmanship, and always hungry—the brothers possess very different qualities, but they are united by a single goal: "Someday, we'll rescue a princess in a cool way!"

Before long, the brothers set out for the seven neighboring kingdoms as ambassadors. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unfamiliar lands?

Set in a medieval-inspired fantasy world, this tale of romance and adventure begins.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Tempal: Item no Chikara
title_japanese: テムパル ～アイテムの力～
synopsis:
Shin Youngwoo (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game "Satisfy," finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: "Pagma's Successor." He's now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game's most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for...

(Source: Tapas Media)

When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?
